input: Commission a custom wedding cake tasting

gold.taskTitle: Commission a Custom Wedding Cake Tasting
gold.taskDescription: Arrange a custom wedding cake tasting session with a baker or bakery to sample and select flavors, fillings, and designs for the wedding cake.

questions.title: What is the wedding date you are planning for?
questions.description: Understanding the wedding date helps determine urgency and how far in advance the tasting needs to be scheduled.

questions.title: Do you already have a specific bakery in mind?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user has a preferred bakery or needs help finding one shapes the first steps of the plan.

questions.title: How many people will attend the tasting session?
questions.description: The number of attendees affects booking requirements and how many portions the bakery needs to prepare.

questions.title: What is your estimated budget for the wedding cake?
questions.description: The overall cake budget will influence which bakeries are suitable and what custom options are realistic to explore.

questions.title: Do you have a cake style or design theme in mind?
questions.description: Knowing the desired aesthetic, such as rustic, modern, floral, or tiered, helps narrow down bakeries that specialize in that style.

questions.title: Are there any dietary restrictions or allergens to accommodate?
questions.description: Allergies or dietary needs such as gluten-free, vegan, or nut-free must be communicated to the bakery before the tasting.

questions.title: What city or area should the bakery be located in?
questions.description: The geographic location is essential for finding and contacting relevant local bakeries for the tasting.
